# directus_translation (Resource)

Manages a Directus custom translation string (directus_translations).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Translation key.
- `language` (String) Language code (e.g. en-US).
- `value` (String) Translated value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned translation UUID.
